<!doctype html><html lang="zh-CN"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1,viewport-fit=cover"><title>数字牧场｜七功能整合 × 小铺与小匣 V1 · 交互审看</title><style>
*{box-sizing:border-box}html,body{margin:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#94daf0;color:#193c58;font-family:"PingFang SC","Microsoft YaHei",system-ui,sans-serif}
#liveArea{position:fixed;inset:0;display:none;border:0;width:100%;height:100%}#liveArea.ready{display:block}
#offline{position:fixed;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(#91d7eb 0 45%,#a0c58a 45% 62%,#6ebd61 62%);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:24px}
#offline .paper{max-width:560px;padding:28px;background:#fff8e3;border:4px solid #315c78;box-shadow:8px 8px #30577466;text-align:center}#offline h1{letter-spacing:.13em}#offline p{line-height:1.9}#offline button,#topTools button{background:#fff8df;border:2px solid #1c5276;padding:7px 13px;font-weight:900;color:#174267;cursor:pointer}
#topTools{position:fixed;right:14px;bottom:13px;z-index:31;display:flex;gap:7px;align-items:center;max-width:95%;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:flex-end;font-size:11px}
#tag{background:#fff8dfde;padding:8px 11px;border:2px solid #274e68;font-size:11px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:2px 2px #31527355}
#cardShade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:100;background:#082e2fb8;visibility:hidden;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .16s steps(4,end);display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;padding:8px}
#cardShade.open{visibility:visible;opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}#cardIframe{width:100%;height:100%;border:0;background:transparent}
#topExit{position:fixed;z-index:101;right:18px;top:14px;padding:7px 13px;border:3px solid #254c3c;background:#f9f0d5;color:#264b3d;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;display:none}#cardShade.open+#topExit{display:block}
#toast{position:fixed;z-index:110;bottom:57px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);background:#fff8e1;border:3px solid #214d6b;padding:10px 20px;box-shadow:5px 5px #163b58aa;font-weight:900;display:none;max-width:90vw;text-align:center}
#toast.show{display:block}
#help{position:fixed;top:12px;left:12px;z-index:35;padding:7px 10px;border:2px solid #234a6d;background:#fffbe9e5;font-size:11px;line-height:1.65;pointer-events:none}
@media(max-width:720px){#help{font-size:10px;max-width:70vw}#tag{display:none}#topTools{bottom:8px;right:8px}#topTools button{font-size:11px;padding:6px}}

/* ---- 小铺 | seventh module, UI preview only. Existing six modules are untouched. ---- */
#shopShade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:96;display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:18px;background:rgba(12,39,48,.78);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain}
#shopShade.open{display:flex}
#shopWindow{--sInk:#2c4a5a;--sWood:#74503d;--sCream:#fff9e9;position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;width:min(1080px,100%);height:min(824px,94dvh);min-height:540px;border:5px solid #304d56;background:#fff7df;color:#2a4e5b;box-shadow:9px 9px 0 #112d38aa;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif}
#shopWindow button,#shopWindow input,#shopWindow textarea,#shopWindow select{font:inherit}
#shopWindow button{cursor:pointer}
#shopWindow button:focus-visible,#shopWindow input:focus-visible,#shopWindow textarea:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #db9c42;outline-offset:3px}
#shopWindow .shopCap{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;flex-shrink:0;gap:10px;padding:9px 14px;color:#fdf0d4;background:#385765;border-bottom:4px solid #273f4c;font-size:12px;font-weight:850;letter-spacing:.09em}
#shopWindow .shopCap .capRight{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
#shopClose{background:#fff3d0!important;border:2px solid #2b4855!important;padding:3px 9px;color:#2a4856!important;font-weight:900}
#shopArt{display:block;width:100%;height:158px;flex-shrink:0;background:#a8d6bd;image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;border-bottom:5px solid #947451}
#shopNav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:0;flex-shrink:0;padding:9px 14px;background:#eedcba;border-bottom:3px solid #9b7a56}
#shopNav button{background:#f9efcf;border:2px solid #85694d;padding:10px 6px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#3b594d;margin-right:-2px;transition:background .07s steps(2,end)}
#shopNav button[aria-selected=true]{background:#4e7766;color:#fff9e9;border-color:#2a5846;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px #234c3f}
#shopBody{flex:1;min-height:0;overflow-y:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:20px clamp(14px,3.8vw,40px);scrollbar-color:#9a8668 #f4e5c5}
#shopBody h2{font:900 clamp(24px,3vw,36px)/1.3 'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;margin:0 0 6px;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#264a41}
#shopBody h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:17px;color:#315242}
#shopBody p{margin:0 0 12px;line-height:1.75}
#shopBody .lead{max-width:800px;color:#66746c;font-size:13px}
#shopBody .shopTag{display:inline-block;border:2px solid #a8916c;background:#fdf5df;padding:3px 7px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em}
#shopBody .tagGreen{border-color:#82a180;background:#eaf3d6;color:#42663b}
#shopBody .tagRed{border-color:#bf9074;background:#f9e6d7;color:#98583a}
#shopBody .woodBtn{display:inline-block;padding:9px 15px;border:2px solid #315a4e;background:#486e54;color:#fff9e9;box-shadow:3px 3px #214b3990;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;min-height:37px}
#shopBody .woodBtn.light{background:#fdf4dc;color:#405d4e;border-color:#7e8e6c}
#shopBody .woodBtn:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:not-allowed;box-shadow:none}
#shopBody .shopTiles{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:15px;margin:22px 0 16px}
#shopBody .tile{background:#fff7e3;border:3px solid #967d56;box-shadow:5px 5px #9c775a34;text-align:left;padding:0;color:#2b5448;overflow:hidden}
#shopBody .tile:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:5px 7px #9c775a58}
#shopBody .tileArt{height:110px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-bottom:3px solid #957754;background:#c8ddaa;color:#49705a;font:bold 54px/1 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:-.1em;text-shadow:3px 3px #fff5d5}
#shopBody .tile:nth-child(2) .tileArt{background:#eed9ad;color:#99764b}#shopBody .tile:nth-child(3) .tileArt{background:#dae6c6;color:#cf855b}
#shopBody .tileInfo{padding:14px}#shopBody .tileInfo b{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.07em}#shopBody .tileInfo small{display:block;font-size:12px;color:#728076;line-height:1.65;margin-top:6px}
#shopBody .paperNote{border-left:5px solid #ae9768;background:#f0e8cf;padding:13px 16px;font-size:12px;line-height:1.75;color:#546758;margin-top:14px}
#shopBody .filterRow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:7px;margin:15px 0}
#shopBody .filterRow button{border:2px solid #99825f;background:#fdf3d9;color:#4c5e4c;padding:6px 12px;font-weight:900;font-size:12px}
#shopBody .filterRow button[aria-pressed=true]{background:#486d56;border-color:#2e5846;color:#fff6dd}
#shopBody .products{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
#shopBody .item{background:#fffdf0;border:2px solid #b6a17b;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:230px}
#shopBody .item figure{margin:0;height:92px;background:#e5e9c8;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
#shopBody .item:nth-child(3n+2) figure{background:#efe0bd}#shopBody .item:nth-child(3n) figure{background:#d8e3d4}
#shopBody .item figure span{font-size:43px;filter:saturate(.55)}
#shopBody .item .itemInfo{padding:12px 13px 13px;display:flex;flex:1;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}
#shopBody .item strong{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:.03em}#shopBody .item small{color:#738076;font-size:11px;line-height:1.55}#shopBody .item .itemActions{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:5px}
#shopBody .item .woodBtn{font-size:11px;padding:7px 8px}
#shopBody .stepStrip{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:16px 0}.stepStrip span{background:#f4e8cb;color:#536451;border:1px solid #bea57c;font-size:12px;padding:7px 10px}.stepStrip b{color:#b87849}
#shopBody .shopPanelRow{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:start;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap}
#shopBody .miniSummary{padding:9px 13px;border:2px solid #bba680;background:#fff5d7;font-size:12px;font-weight:900}
#shopBody .supportPaper{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1.15fr) minmax(230px,.85fr);gap:22px;margin-top:20px}
#shopBody .paperFront{border:3px solid #92795b;background:#fffbed;padding:21px;box-shadow:5px 5px #99795730}
#shopBody .supportChoices{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;margin:11px 0}
#shopBody label{font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#48634d;display:block;margin-bottom:5px}
#shopBody .supportChoices label{border:2px solid #a78d6b;padding:9px 10px;background:#f8eed5;cursor:pointer;margin:0;font-weight:700}
#shopBody .supportChoices input{accent-color:#4d7955}
#shopBody input[type=number],#shopBody input[type=text],#shopBody textarea{background:#fffdf3;border:2px solid #9a9278;border-radius:0;width:100%;padding:10px 11px;color:#344d44;min-height:41px}
#shopBody textarea{resize:vertical;min-height:70px}
#shopBody .privacy{border:2px dashed #a89475;padding:17px;background:#f1e6cb;line-height:1.8;color:#60705f;font-size:12px}
#shopWindow .shopFoot{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;padding:8px 16px;border-top:3px solid #aa8964;background:#ead6ac;color:#516651;font-size:10px;font-weight:850;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.6}
#shopWindow #shopMsg{display:none;position:absolute;bottom:41px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:8;background:#f9efcc;border:3px solid #486d51;padding:10px 14px;box-shadow:3px 3px #294e4299;max-width:90%;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-align:center}
#shopWindow #shopMsg.on{display:block}
#shopWindow .shopDialog{display:none;position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:12;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:15px;background:#12382db5}
#shopWindow .shopDialog.on{display:flex}
#shopWindow .dialogPaper{background:#fff8e2;color:#315445;border:4px solid #345747;padding:23px;max-width:455px;width:100%;box-shadow:6px 6px #172f29aa}
#shopWindow .dialogPaper h3{font-size:20px;margin:0 0 6px}#shopWindow .dialogPaper p{font-size:12px;line-height:1.7}#shopWindow .dialogBtns{display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:flex-end;margin-top:14px}
#shopWindow .dialogBtns button{padding:8px 12px;border:2px solid #3a624b;background:#f9e8c0;color:#405c4d;font-weight:800}
#shopWindow .dialogBtns .submit{background:#446e51;color:#fff7db}
@media(max-width:780px){#shopShade{padding:0}#shopWindow{min-height:100dvh;height:100dvh;border:0;box-shadow:none}#shopArt{height:113px}#shopBody{padding:15px 13px 18px}#shopBody .shopTiles{gap:7px}#shopBody .tileArt{height:70px;font-size:36px}#shopBody .tileInfo{padding:8px}#shopBody .tileInfo b{font-size:15px}#shopBody .tileInfo small{font-size:10px}#shopBody .products{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:9px}#shopBody .supportPaper{grid-template-columns:1fr}#shopWindow .shopFoot{font-size:9px;padding:6px 10px}#shopNav{padding:6px 8px}#shopNav button{padding:9px 3px;font-size:12px}}
@media(max-width:360px){#shopBody .products{grid-template-columns:1fr}}

/* ===== 小匣: private settings attached to identity; not an eighth main button ===== */
#boxShade{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:98;background:rgba(12,37,37,.76);display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;overscroll-behavior:contain}
#boxShade.open{display:flex}
#boxWindow{position:relative;color:#294b46;background:#f8f0d9;border:5px solid #345348;box-shadow:9px 9px 0 #102d2aaa;width:min(855px,100%);height:min(735px,93dvh);display:flex;flex-direction:column;font-family:'PingFang SC','Microsoft YaHei',sans-serif;overflow:hidden}
#boxWindow button,#boxWindow input{font:inherit}#boxWindow button{cursor:pointer}#boxWindow button:focus-visible,#boxWindow input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b47b46;outline-offset:2px}
.boxTop{background:#345647;color:#fff6df;padding:10px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;border-bottom:4px solid #213b32;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;flex-shrink:0}
#boxClose{background:#fff1ce;color:#345647;padding:5px 10px;border:2px solid #183d32;font-weight:900;white-space:nowrap}
#boxArt{height:116px;width:100%;object-fit:fill;image-rendering:pixelated;border-bottom:4px solid #967449;flex-shrink:0;background:#b3d0bd}
#boxBodyGrid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:212px minmax(0,1fr);flex:1;min-height:0}
#boxAside{background:#e1d2ac;border-right:3px solid #9c8155;padding:19px 14px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
#boxAside .boxMark{font:900 10px/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.15em;color:#6d5c46}#boxAside h2{font-size:30px;margin:0;color:#365848;letter-spacing:.18em}#boxAside .asideNote{font-size:12px;color:#6c6e59;line-height:1.75;margin:0 0 10px}
#boxTabs{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px}#boxTabs button{border:2px solid #a68b5e;box-shadow:3px 3px #a2855540;background:#f7edcf;color:#48644d;padding:10px 10px;font-size:13px;font-weight:900;text-align:left}#boxTabs button[aria-selected=true]{background:#4f765c;border-color:#2f5945;color:#fff8e4;box-shadow:inset 0 -3px #2a4d3b}
#boxAside .tiny{margin-top:auto;font-size:10px;line-height:1.75;color:#817459;border-top:1px dashed #a58f67;padding-top:10px}
#boxContent{background:#fffae9;padding:22px clamp(16px,3vw,29px);overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;min-height:0}
#boxContent h3{font-size:22px;color:#315440;margin:0 0 6px;letter-spacing:.1em}#boxContent .intro{font-size:12px;color:#7b7f67;line-height:1.7;margin:0 0 19px}
#boxContent .paper{background:#fffdf2;border:2px solid #c3ad83;padding:17px;margin-bottom:12px;box-shadow:4px 4px #ad926322}
#boxContent .miniHead{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;color:#8e805f;font-weight:900;margin:0 0 8px}#boxContent .codeLine{font:900 clamp(17px,2.65vw,25px)/1.4 ui-monospace,monospace;letter-spacing:.05em;color:#315440;word-break:break-word}
#boxContent .sub{font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;color:#77806c;margin:8px 0 0}#boxContent label{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;color:#446449;margin-bottom:7px}
#boxContent input[type=text]{border:2px solid #a79571;background:#fdf8e7;color:#345345;padding:9px 11px;width:100%;font-size:15px;min-height:42px;border-radius:0}
#boxContent .actions{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:9px;margin-top:11px;align-items:center}#boxContent button.boxBtn{border:2px solid #345d48;background:#4f7659;color:#fff9e6;padding:8px 13px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;min-height:38px}#boxContent button.boxBtn.ghost{background:#f7edd0;color:#46604b;border-color:#998b69}
#boxContent .pill{font-size:10px;border:1px solid #97a483;background:#e9f2d6;color:#3d6c4d;font-weight:900;padding:4px 7px;display:inline-block}#boxContent .pill.wait{background:#f6e8cb;color:#876d48;border-color:#baa07b}
#boxContent .option{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:10px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px dashed #c7b78f}#boxContent .option:last-child{border-bottom:0}#boxContent .option b{font-size:14px}#boxContent .option small{display:block;font-size:11px;color:#77806c;line-height:1.6;margin-top:5px;max-width:340px}#boxContent .toggle{flex:0 0 auto;min-width:72px;padding:8px 10px;border:2px solid #9f8d6c;font:900 11px/1 ui-monospace,monospace;background:#e4d4b2;color:#6c6858}#boxContent .toggle[aria-pressed=true]{background:#4b765d;border-color:#356047;color:#fff7dc}
#boxContent .warn{border-left:4px solid #b88856;padding:10px 13px;background:#f4e8cf;color:#6b674f;font-size:12px;line-height:1.75}
.boxBottom{padding:8px 16px;border-top:3px solid #a38a62;background:#efe0b8;color:#746d58;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;align-items:center;font-size:10px;flex-shrink:0;line-height:1.4}
#boxWindow.box-quiet *,#boxWindow.box-quiet *:before,#boxWindow.box-quiet *:after{animation:none!important;transition:none!important}
#boxToast{position:absolute;bottom:48px;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);z-index:5;background:#fdf2d0;padding:9px 14px;border:3px solid #4f7659;box-shadow:4px 4px #24433399;display:none;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;text-align:center;width:max-content;max-width:90%}#boxToast.show{display:block}
@media(max-width:720px){#boxShade{padding:0}#boxWindow{width:100%;height:100dvh;max-height:none;border:0;box-shadow:none}#boxArt{height:89px}#boxBodyGrid{grid-template-columns:1fr;grid-template-rows:auto minmax(0,1fr)}#boxAside{border-right:0;border-bottom:3px solid #a38b65;padding:11px 13px;gap:4px}#boxAside h2{font-size:23px}#boxAside .asideNote,#boxAside .tiny{display:none}#boxTabs{flex-direction:row;gap:5px;margin-top:5px}#boxTabs button{flex:1;text-align:center;padding:7px 5px;font-size:12px;box-shadow:none}#boxContent{padding:19px 16px}.boxBottom{font-size:9px}}
</style></head><body>
<iframe id="liveArea" title="已开发数字牧场功能区"></iframe>
<div id="offline"><div class="paper"><h1>同路 · 数字牧场</h1><p id="loadStatus">正在读取先前已经完成的真实功能区……</p><button id="offlineCard" type="button">▤　体验步道卡</button> <button id="offlineShop" type="button">⌂　直接审看小铺</button> <button id="offlineBox" type="button">▣　直接审看小匣</button><p style="font-size:12px">此整合样机从 GitHub 已有的功能区原型读取界面，并采用 budao.org 当前牧场景观；没有替换或重新绘制其他板块。</p><p style="font-size:11px"><a target="_blank" rel="noopener" href="https://github.com/Tonykao1/budao.org/blob/feature/tonglu-pixel-pasture-v1/tonglu-function-zone-preview.html">查看原功能区源码</a></p></div></div>
<div id="help">同路原野 · 整合审看版<br><span id="phaseText">未激活：先领取步道卡 · 无限快速预览</span></div>
<div id="topTools"><span id="tag">七个主功能 + 私人小匣</span><button id="floatingCard" type="button">▤　步道卡</button><button id="floatingShop" type="button" title="仅供审看，绕过激活限制以检查小铺界面">⌂　小铺预览</button><button id="floatingBox" type="button" title="仅供审看，小匣正式入口位于左上角身份卡">▣　小匣预览</button><button id="reset" type="button" title="仅重置演示身份，不是正式功能">↺ 样机重置</button></div>
<div id="cardShade"><iframe id="cardIframe" title="像素步道卡激活交互"></iframe></div><button id="topExit" type="button">收起 ×</button><div id="toast" role="status"></div>
<script>
(async()=>{
const ORIGINAL=`
